With NOWPayments, creators can retain a larger portion of their earnings, making it an attractive alternative for those [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-explained-digital-creators-14|COREMERCH guide to selling]] ebooks, courses, and other digital products.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Usdt payment

A USDT payment gateway enables digital creators to accept payments in Tether (USDT), a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar, providing a reliable currency for transactions. Unlike conventional payment processors that impose significant fees, such as Gumroad’s 10% per sale, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This difference can add up quickly; for instance, on 100 sales of a $97 product, the fee difference retains an impressive $921. This retention allows creators to reinvest into their businesses, enhancing their offerings or expanding their reach.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind a USDT payment gateway combines various components for seamless operation. At its core, NOWPayments processes transactions on-chain, ensuring secure and immediate payment confirmations. Additionally, creators can host their digital products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, linking their stores directly to the payment gateway. By utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate delivery of their products upon transaction confirmation, ensuring a smooth customer experience while minimizing manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where access to traditional payment processors is limited or non-existent. It empowers those selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products to operate independently, without the constraints of conventional platforms. By leveraging a USDT payment gateway, these creators can bypass the challenges posed by financial isolation, currency instability, and high transaction fees, ultimately enabling them to focus on what matters most: creating and selling their work.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, far lower than traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully set up a USDT payment gateway, several components are critical. First, you need a reliable hosting service, such as GitHub Pages, to store your digital products. Then, utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script allows you to handle backend logic and automate product delivery. Pair this with NOWPayments for processing USDT transactions, and you have a complete system that minimizes costs and maximizes efficiency. Together, these components create a robust infrastructure that supports seamless digital commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own USDT payment gateway, start by signing up for NOWPayments and creating an account. Next, set up your product listings on a platform like GitHub Pages. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your digital products. Ensure that you configure your payment gateway to convert pricing into USDT at transaction time for real-time accuracy. Finally, promote your store through social media or other channels to attract customers and begin making sales.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a USDT payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments directly in cryptocurrency, eliminating the need for conventional payment platforms. With low transaction fees and automated delivery options, you can streamline your sales process while maximizing revenue.
Automate product delivery with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for efficiency.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all the blueprints and templates needed to create your own sovereign digital commerce stack, enabling you to operate independently from traditional payment processors.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
